description:
We are looking for an experienced Institutional Sales / Business Development professional who understands how to sell complex education solutions to schools, educational institutions, and decision\-makers.

This is not a conventional field\-sales role. You will be responsible for selling Innovation Labs, Makerspaces, STEM/STEAM programs, curriculum, learning modules, and related education solutions to schools and institutions.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience selling Innovation Labs, STEM/Robotics Labs, EdTech solutions, curriculum, educational technology, assessments, SaaS, or similar institutional solutions and should be comfortable engaging directly with school owners, trustees, principals, management teams, and other senior decision\-makers.

You should be able to understand an institution's requirements, conduct a consultative discussion, demonstrate our solutions, build a business case, manage the sales cycle, negotiate with decision\-makers, and convert opportunities into long\-term partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the complete sales cycle for Innovation Labs, Makerspaces, STEM/STEAM programs, curriculum, learning solutions, and related products.
* Identify and develop relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, directors, academic heads, and senior management.
* Generate and develop a strong pipeline of institutional opportunities through direct outreach, references, networking, partnerships, events, and market development.
* Conduct consultative discussions with institutions to understand their requirements, existing infrastructure, academic objectives, budgets, and future plans.
* Present and demonstrate Makerspace Masters' Innovation Labs, learning modules, curriculum, technology solutions, and overall value proposition to decision\-makers.
* Conduct product demos, presentations, workshops, and solution discussions with schools and institutions.
* Prepare and present customized proposals based on the institution's requirements.
* Work closely with internal curriculum, design, technical, project, and operations teams to develop suitable solutions for clients.
* Manage the complete sales process from lead generation and qualification through proposal, negotiation, closure, and handover.
* Build strong relationships with key decision\-makers and develop opportunities for repeat business, expansion, and referrals.
* Maintain accurate sales pipeline, opportunity stages, forecasts, and follow\-ups through the company's CRM.
* Meet and exceed assigned revenue and business development targets.
* Travel extensively to meet schools and institutions and attend relevant education and industry events when required.
* Track market trends, competitor offerings, pricing, and emerging opportunities in the Innovation Lab, STEM, EdTech, and school education space.
* Represent Makerspace Masters professionally and build strong relationships with educational institutions across the assigned territory.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 4–8\+ years of experience in institutional sales, B2B sales, consultative selling, or business development.
* Prior experience selling to schools, colleges, educational institutions, or education groups is strongly preferred.
* Experience selling one or more of the following will be highly relevant:
* Innovation Labs / Makerspaces
* STEM / STEAM / Robotics Labs
* EdTech solutions
* School curriculum
* Educational software / SaaS
* Student assessment solutions
* Digital learning solutions
* Smart classrooms / AV / educational technology
* STEM kits / educational products
* Proven experience engaging with school owners, trustees, principals, directors, and senior management.
* Strong consultative selling and solution\-selling skills.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations and business presentations confidently.
* Strong understanding of the institutional sales cycle and decision\-making process within schools.
* Ability to understand a customer's requirement and translate it into an appropriate solution.
* Strong negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets and closing institutional deals.
* Willingness to travel extensively as required.

**A Strong Advantage**

Candidates with experience in selling complete labs, innovation centres, STEM/robotics labs, curriculum programs, or technology\-enabled learning solutions to schools will be particularly relevant for this role.

Experience managing longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and higher\-value institutional deals will also be an advantage.

**What You'll Be Selling**

Makerspace Masters provides institutions with complete innovation and learning ecosystems rather than a single product. Our solutions include Innovation Labs and Makerspaces, STEM/robotics and technology infrastructure, hands\-on learning modules, curriculum support, teacher resources, and digital learning/engagement solutions. Our offering spans areas such as robotics, mechatronics, 3D printing, digital fabrication, woodworking, pottery, AR/VR, media and other interdisciplinary learning experiences.

**Why Join Us?**

* Sell a differentiated education solution rather than a conventional product.
* Competitive fixed compensation with performance\-linked incentives and no ceiling on earning potential.
* Direct access to leadership and the opportunity to influence business growth.
* Opportunity to build and own your institutional sales territory.
* Product training, demo support, presentations, marketing collateral, and ready\-to\-use sales resources.
* Opportunity to work directly with school owners, principals, trustees, and senior education leaders.
* Fast\-growing organization with opportunities to take on larger responsibilities as the business expands.
* Recognition and rewards for strong performance.
* Travel opportunities across India.

**Role overview**  
The CRM \& Lead Manager is responsible for capturing every lead generated from Meta (Facebook / Instagram ) ads, Indiamart and Alibaba, qualifying them quickly, and handing them off to the right outlet sales executive for closure. This person owns the full lead lifecycle \- from the moment a form is filled on an ad to the point of first sales contact. They also maintain the CRM database, track follow\-up status, and report lead conversion metrics to the COO weekly.

**Lead flow this role manages**  
Meta Ad Lead/ Indiamart Lead/ Alibaba Lead→CRM Entry→Qualification Call→Assign to Sales Exec→Track \& Follow\-up→Closure / Report

**Key responsibilities**

**Lead capture \& CRM entry** \- Pull leads from Meta Ads Manager / lead form integrations daily (morning). Enter each lead into CRM (Zoho, Leadsquared, Google Sheet, or WhatsApp CRM) with source, product interest, location, and contact details. Zero lead should be missed.  
**First response \& qualification** \- Call or WhatsApp every new lead within 30 minutes of capture. Understand their requirement — product type, quantity, location, timeline, and budget. Tag leads as Hot / Warm / Cold based on the conversation.  
**Lead assignment to sales executives** \- Route qualified leads to the nearest franchise outlet's sales executive based on the lead's location. Share all lead details on WhatsApp or CRM. Confirm the executive has received and will follow up.  
**Follow\-up tracking** \- Monitor whether assigned sales executives have followed up within the agreed TAT. Send daily reminders for pending follow\-ups. Escalate unattended leads to the Sales Coordinator or MD after 24 hours.  
**Lead nurturing for cold leads \-** For leads that are not ready to buy immediately, maintain a follow\-up schedule \- weekly check\-ins via WhatsApp or call. Share product brochures, price lists, or offers to keep them engaged.  
**CRM database management** \- Keep the CRM updated at all times \- lead status, last contact date, next follow\-up date, and outcome. Ensure no lead is left stale for more than 7 days without an update.  
**Weekly lead MIS report** \- Prepare and share a weekly report covering: total leads received, leads by source / campaign, qualification rate, assignment status, and conversion rate by outlet. Present to MD every Monday.  
**Ad feedback to marketing** \- Based on lead quality patterns (wrong locations, irrelevant queries, low\-quality leads), share weekly feedback with whoever manages Meta Ads to improve targeting and ad creative.

First response time \- Within 30 mins of lead capture  
Lead entry accuracy \- 100% leads logged, zero missed

CRM hygiene \-No lead stale beyond 7 days
